channel.title: Crime Expos? With Nancy O'Dell
channel.desc: A 911 call reports a car accident on a quiet Wisconsin road that ends with a pipe shattering a windshield and a wife gravely injured. Her eventual death appears to be an unfortunate accident, but as small clues accumulate, investigators methodically retrace every moment to determine whether it was a freak accident or a cover story for something more sinister.
